zh-Hant.title: 1.4.3 有什麼新功能
highlights: 新版本推出時會在 App 內提醒你更新。
升級後首次開啟會顯示這個「新功能」說明。

en.title: What's new in 1.4.3
highlights: The app now reminds you in-app when a new version is available.
After upgrading, this "What's new" summary appears on first launch.

zh-Hant.title: 2.0.0 有什麼新功能
highlights: 跨裝置同步：課表、課程顏色與作業狀態可以在你的裝置之間同步，可在「設定」中關閉。
新增了 GPA 即時計算，不需要等待學校系統出來。
修復了許多 bug。
顯示該頁面使用的伺服器以及其狀態。
其他許多大改進與變化。

en.title: What's new in 2.0.0
highlights: Cross-device sync: your timetable, course colours and assignment state can follow you between devices. Turn it off in Settings.
Added real-time GPA calculation, no need to wait for the school system.
Many bug fixes.
Shows which server is used for this page and its status.
Many other improvements and changes.

zh-Hant.title: 2.0.1 有什麼新功能（沿用 v2.0.0 內容）
highlights: 因為 Play Store 跳過 v2.0.0，故此版本新內容沿用 v2.0.0 內容。
跨裝置同步：課表、課程顏色與作業狀態可以在你的裝置之間同步，可在「設定」中關閉。
新增了 GPA 即時計算，不需要等待學校系統出來。
修復了許多 bug。
顯示該頁面使用的伺服器以及其狀態。
其他許多大改進與變化。

en.title: What's new in 2.0.1
highlights: Due to Play Store skipping v2.0.0, the new features in this version are the same as v2.0.0.
Cross-device sync: your timetable, course colours and assignment state can follow you between devices. Turn it off in Settings.
Added real-time GPA calculation, no need to wait for the school system.
Many bug fixes.
Shows which server is used for this page and its status.
Many other improvements and changes.

zh-Hant.title: 2.0.2 新功能
highlights: 課表時間修正。
修正 TigerSync 相關詞匯。
修正 Widget 顯示成其他版面或錯誤畫面的問題。
翻譯優化。
行事曆顯示優化。

en.title: What's new in 2.0.2
highlights: Class table time correction
Fix TigerSync related terms
Fix the problem of Widget displaying other layouts or error screens
Translation optimization
Calendar display optimization
